blocks.content:
Evaluation behavior sets how often Grafana runs your query and how long a problem must last before the alert fires.

In this milestone, you create an evaluation group and set a pending period.
In the **Set evaluation behavior** section, click **New evaluation group** to open the dialog.
Give the group a name, such as **Alerts group**, set the **Evaluation interval** to **1m**, then click **Create**.
Find the **Pending period** field. This is how long the condition must stay true before the alert fires. Set it to **1m** — brief spikes get filtered out, but a real problem fires quickly.
Your alert now has a folder, a label, and an evaluation schedule. Next, you'll pick who gets notified when the alert fires.
